cell_line.evidence: HITB5 human vascular smooth muscle cells from Cellutions Biosystems were cultured in M199 medium (25 mM HEPES, Invitrogen, Cat: 12340–030) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, and 100 units/ml penicillin, and maintained in 5% CO2 at 37 °C.
A10 rat thoracic aorta vascular smooth muscle cells from ATCC were cultured in DMEM supplemented with with 10% fetal bovine serum, and 100 units/ml penicillin.
Cells from ATCC were maintained at 37 °C in 5% CO2 in DMEM (Life Technologies) supplemented with 10% FBS (Life Technologies) and 1% penicillin-streptomycin (Life Technologies).
